question: What breed is the user's dog?

haystack_sessions.content: I love hiking on the weekends. The trails near my house are gorgeous in spring.
That sounds wonderful. Do you have a favorite trail?
My dog Rufus came hiking with me today. He is a border collie and absolutely tireless on the trail.
Border collies are amazing hiking companions. Rufus must have had a blast.
I tried a new sourdough recipe this morning. The crust came out perfect.
Nicely done. Sourdough crust is tricky to get right.
